title: Legendária engine config
description: Engine settings. Put only the keys you want to change in your user config.json (see `flosub config path`).

model.description: Model name from models.json (e.g. small, medium, large-v3-turbo) or a path to a CTranslate2 model folder.

language.description: Speech language code (pt, en, es, ...) or 'auto' to detect it.

device.description: 'auto' uses an NVIDIA GPU when available, otherwise the CPU.

beam_size.description: Beam search width: higher is slightly more accurate and slower.

vad_filter.description: Skip silent parts with voice activity detection (reduces made-up text).

word_timestamps.description: Record the timing of every word (needed for CapCut-style captions).

ui_languages.description: Languages offered in the Blender add-on's language menu.

style.description: Style used by `flosub transcribe`/`export` when --style is not given (a key of 'styles').

styles.description: Cue styles: how words are grouped into on-screen text. 'pop' = one word at a time (two when the first is very short), for pop animations; 'captions' = short CapCut-style phrases (Blender default); 'subtitles' = film-style lines (SRT/VTT default). Add your own.

line_length.description: SRT/VTT: wrap cues longer than this into two lines.

max_duration.description: Longest time (s) a cue may cover.

min_duration.description: Shortest time (s) a cue stays on screen (stretched without overlapping the next).

pause_break.description: A silence longer than this (s) starts a new cue.

break_after.description: Punctuation characters that end a cue.

break_on_segment.description: Start a new cue at each Whisper segment.

join_short.description: A single word with at most this many letters ("a", "de", "no") may take the next word, even beyond max_words.

fill_gaps.description: Extend a cue to the next one when the silence between them is at most this many seconds (avoids blinking).
